title: 視訊會議的連線狀況

dialogue.text: Karen, can you hear me? I think something's wrong with my microphone.
I can hear you fine, but your video is frozen. It stopped about a minute ago.
Sorry about that. Let me turn my camera off and back on.
Try that. Are you on the office network today, or are you at home?
I'm working from home. The connection's been slow all morning.
That's probably it. Why don't you close the other programs you have open? That usually helps.
Okay, I just closed my email and the file I was reading. How is it now?
Much better. I can see you clearly.
Good. So should we wait for Mr. Okada? He hasn't joined yet.
He sent me a message. He's still on a call with a client, so he'll be about ten minutes late.
Then let's start with the budget and leave the schedule until he's here.
Sounds good. I'll take notes and send them to everyone afterward.

questions.q: What is the problem at the beginning of the conversation?
options: The woman cannot find the meeting link
The meeting room is being used by another team
The man has not prepared his materials
The man's video is not working properly
questions.explanation: 定位在前兩句：男子說 something's wrong with my microphone（我的麥克風好像有問題）,女子回 I can hear you fine, but your video is frozen（我聽得很清楚,但你的畫面卡住了）。聲音其實沒問題,真正出狀況的是畫面,選 (D)。(A) 兩人已經在同一個會議中,沒有找不到連結的問題;(B) 全程沒有提到會議室;(C) 男子只關掉正在看的檔案,不是沒準備資料。

questions.q: What does the woman suggest the man do?
options: Close the other programs he is using
Restart his computer
Come into the office
Call the technical support desk
questions.explanation: 定位在女子第三次發言：Why don't you close the other programs you have open?（要不要把你開著的其他程式關掉?）Why don't you 是提出建議的常見句型,選 (A)。(B) 男子只重開了相機,沒有重開電腦;(C) 女子只是問他今天在不在辦公室,沒有叫他進公司;(D) 對話中沒有提到技術支援。

questions.q: What will the speakers most likely do next?
options: End the meeting early
Talk about the budget
Wait until Mr. Okada joins
Send an email to a client
questions.explanation: 定位在男子最後一句：let's start with the budget and leave the schedule until he's here（我們先從預算開始,行程表等他來再談）,女子回 Sounds good（好啊）。兩人已經談定下一步先討論預算,選 (B)。(C) 正好相反,他們決定不等 Mr. Okada;(A) 沒有要提早結束;(D) 打電話給客戶的是 Mr. Okada,不是這兩人要做的事。

transcriptZh:
男：Karen,聽得到我說話嗎?我的麥克風好像有問題。
女：我聽得很清楚,但你的畫面卡住了,大概一分鐘前就不動了。
男：不好意思。我把相機關掉再打開看看。
女：試試看。你今天是用公司的網路,還是在家?
男：我今天在家工作,網路一整個早上都很慢。
女：那大概就是原因了。要不要把你開著的其他程式關掉?通常會有幫助。
男：好,我剛把信箱和正在看的檔案關掉了。現在呢?
女：好多了,我可以清楚看到你。
男：太好了。那我們要等 Okada 先生嗎?他還沒進來。
女：他傳訊息給我了,他還在跟客戶通電話,大概會晚十分鐘。
男：那我們先從預算開始,行程表等他來再談。
女：好啊。我來做紀錄,結束後再寄給大家。

title: 飯店櫃檯的房型調整

dialogue.text: Good afternoon. I have a reservation under Patrick Hale, three nights.
Welcome, Mr. Hale. Let me find it. Yes, here it is. A standard room with one large bed, checking out Friday.
That's right. Is there any chance of a room on a higher floor? Last time I stayed here, the street noise kept me awake.
Let me see what we have. Actually, we had a cancellation this morning, so I can move you to the fifteenth floor. That room is larger and it has a desk by the window.
That sounds great. Is there an extra charge for it?
Normally it's forty dollars more per night, but you're in our rewards program, so I won't charge you anything.
Wonderful, thank you. And what time does breakfast start?
Six thirty to ten, in the restaurant on the second floor. Your rate includes breakfast for one person.
Good to know. Is the fitness center open in the evening?
It's open twenty-four hours. You just need your key card to get in.
Perfect. Oh, one more thing. Could I have a late checkout on Friday?
I can't promise it now, but call the front desk Thursday night and we'll do our best.

questions.q: Why does the man ask about a different room?
options: He wants to be closer to the elevator
He was bothered by noise during an earlier stay
His room is not ready yet
He needs space to hold a meeting
questions.explanation: 定位在男子第二次發言：Last time I stayed here, the street noise kept me awake（上次我住這裡,街上的噪音吵得我睡不著）。他想換到高樓層是因為之前被噪音影響,選 (B)。(A) 完全沒提電梯;(C) 女子沒說房間還沒整理好,反而馬上就能安排;(D) 他是來住宿的,沒有提到開會。

questions.q: What does the woman say about the cost of the new room?
options: It will be forty dollars each night
It will be added to the final bill
The man will not have to pay extra
The man's company will pay for it
questions.explanation: 定位在女子第三次發言：Normally it's forty dollars more per night, but you're in our rewards program, so I won't charge you anything（平常一晚要多收四十元,但您是會員,所以我不收費）。關鍵在 but 之後的轉折,選 (C)。(A) 是原價,不是實際要付的金額,屬於典型的數字陷阱;(B) 女子明說不收費;(D) 沒有提到公司付款。

questions.q: What does the woman suggest the man do on Thursday night?
options: Contact the front desk
Return his key card
Order breakfast in advance
Visit the fitness center
questions.explanation: 定位在最後一句：call the front desk Thursday night and we'll do our best（星期四晚上打給櫃檯,我們會盡量安排）。這是針對延遲退房的建議,選 (A)。(B) 房卡是用來進健身房的,不是要退還;(C) 早餐已含在房價中,不需要預訂;(D) 健身房二十四小時開放,和星期四晚上無關。

transcriptZh:
男：午安,我有訂房,名字是 Patrick Hale,住三晚。
女：Hale 先生您好,我查一下。有了,標準房、一張大床,星期五退房。
男：沒錯。請問有可能換到高一點的樓層嗎?上次我住這裡,街上的噪音吵得我睡不著。
女：我看看還有什麼房。剛好今天早上有人取消,我可以幫您換到十五樓。那間比較大,窗邊還有書桌。
男：聽起來很好。需要另外加錢嗎?
女：平常一晚要多收四十元,不過您是我們會員方案的客人,所以我不另外收費。
男：太好了,謝謝。那早餐幾點開始?
女：六點半到十點,在二樓的餐廳。您的房價含一位早餐。
男：知道了。健身房晚上有開嗎?
女：二十四小時開放,只要用房卡就能進去。
男：太好了。喔,還有一件事,星期五可以延遲退房嗎?
女：我現在沒辦法保證,但您星期四晚上打給櫃檯,我們會盡量安排。

title: 辦公用品供應商比價

dialogue.text: Sam, did you finish comparing the two office supply companies? The purchase order has to go out Friday.
Almost. I have quotes from both. Weston Office Direct is cheaper on paper and folders, but delivery takes about a week.
A week? We usually run out of printer paper before that.
That's what worries me too. The other one, Nakamura Supply, is about eight percent more expensive, but they deliver in two days and there's no minimum order.
Eight percent isn't nothing. What do we spend in a month, roughly?
Around twelve hundred dollars. So we'd be paying about a hundred more each month.
That's less than I expected. And with Weston we'd have to keep more in the storage room, which is already full.
True. And Nakamura gives us a discount if we sign for a full year.
How much of a discount?
Five percent off every order. That makes the difference between the two almost nothing.
Then let's go with Nakamura. Could you write it up and send it to me before lunch? I'll take it to Ms. Bennett for approval.
Sure. I'll put both quotes in the same file so she can see the numbers side by side.

questions.q: What are the speakers mainly discussing?
options: Moving into a larger storage room
Limiting how much each department orders
Choosing a company to buy office supplies from
Setting the price of a new product
questions.explanation: 定位在女子開頭：did you finish comparing the two office supply companies?（你把兩家辦公用品公司比較完了嗎?）之後兩人一路討論價格、到貨時間與折扣,最後決定選 Nakamura。整段主題就是挑供應商,選 (C)。(A) 倉庫太滿只是其中一個考量,不是主題;(B) 沒有討論限制各部門的訂購;(D) 他們是買方,不是在訂價。

questions.q: What is the main disadvantage of Weston Office Direct?
options: It charges more than the other company
Its deliveries take too long
It requires a large minimum order
It does not sell printer paper
questions.explanation: 定位在男子第一次發言：Weston Office Direct is cheaper on paper and folders, but delivery takes about a week（Weston 的紙和資料夾比較便宜,但到貨要一星期）,女子隨即說公司常在那之前就把影印紙用完。缺點在於出貨太慢,選 (B)。(A) 恰好相反,Weston 比較便宜;(C) 沒有最低訂購量的是 Nakamura,選項把兩家的資訊對調;(D) Weston 有賣紙,只是送得慢。

questions.q: What will the man most likely do next?
options: Telephone Ms. Bennett
Visit the supplier's office
Order more printer paper
Prepare a document for the woman
questions.explanation: 定位在最後兩句：女子說 Could you write it up and send it to me before lunch?（可以寫好在午餐前寄給我嗎?）男子答應並說會把兩份報價放在同一個檔案裡。他接下來要做的是整理文件,選 (D)。(A) 拿去給 Bennett 女士的是女子,不是他;(B) 沒有提到要拜訪供應商;(C) 影印紙只是舉例說明用量,不是他下一步的動作。

transcriptZh:
女：Sam,你把那兩家辦公用品公司比較完了嗎?採購單星期五就要送出去。
男：快好了。兩家的報價我都拿到了。Weston Office Direct 的紙和資料夾比較便宜,但到貨大概要一星期。
女：一星期?我們通常在那之前影印紙就用完了。
男：我也是擔心這點。另一家 Nakamura Supply 大約貴百分之八,但兩天到貨,而且沒有最低訂購量。
女：百分之八也不算少。我們一個月大概花多少?
男：一千二百元左右,所以一個月大概多付一百元。
女：比我想的少。而且如果選 Weston,我們得在倉庫多囤一些,可是倉庫已經滿了。
男：對。而且如果簽一整年,Nakamura 會給折扣。
女：折多少?
男：每一筆訂單都打九五折,這樣兩家的差距幾乎就沒了。
女：那就選 Nakamura。你可以寫好在午餐前寄給我嗎?我拿去給 Bennett 女士核准。
男：沒問題。我會把兩份報價放在同一個檔案裡,讓她可以並排看數字。

title: 健身房會員方案諮詢

dialogue.text: Hi. I walk past your gym on my way to work every day, so I thought I'd come in and ask about joining.
Happy to help. Are you thinking about a monthly plan or a yearly one?
I'm not sure yet. What's the difference?
The monthly plan is fifty dollars and you can stop any time. The yearly plan works out to forty a month, but you pay six months up front.
I see. What does that include?
Both plans give you everything on the main floor — the machines, the weights, and the pool. Group classes are ten dollars each unless you add the class package.
How much is the package?
Fifteen dollars more a month, and then classes are free. If you take two or more a month, it pays for itself.
That's useful. I'd probably come early, before eight in the morning. Is it crowded then?
Between six and seven it's busy, mostly people coming before work. After seven thirty it's pretty quiet.
Good. Could I try the gym once before I decide?
Of course. Bring a photo ID and we'll give you a free day pass. You can use it any day this week.

questions.q: Why is the woman at the gym?
options: To ask about becoming a member
To return a piece of equipment
To sign up for a morning class
To meet a friend for exercise
questions.explanation: 定位在女子第一句：I thought I'd come in and ask about joining（我想說進來問問入會的事）,後面整段都在問方案、費用與人潮。她的目的是了解會員方案,選 (A)。(B) 沒有提到歸還器材;(C) 課程只是她順口問到的一部分,她還沒報名;(D) 沒有提到朋友。

questions.q: What does the man say about the class package?
options: It is free for yearly members
It is only available in the morning
It includes the use of the pool
It costs fifteen dollars a month
questions.explanation: 定位在男子第三次發言：Fifteen dollars more a month, and then classes are free（一個月多十五元,課程就免費）。加購課程方案本身一個月要十五元,選 (D)。(A) 免費的是課程,不是方案本身,而且和年約無關;(B) 沒有說課程只在早上;(C) 游泳池兩種方案都含,不是課程方案的內容,屬於資訊錯置的誘答。

questions.q: What does the man imply about the early morning?
options: The pool is closed at that time
No classes are offered before eight
The gym is crowded for about an hour
There are no staff members on duty
questions.explanation: 定位在男子第四次發言：Between six and seven it's busy... After seven thirty it's pretty quiet（六點到七點很多人……七點半以後就滿安靜的）。可以推知早上只有一小段時間人多,選 (C)。(A) 完全沒說泳池關閉;(B) 男子沒有說早上不開課;(D) 沒有提到人手,而且他還說可以拿一日體驗券來用。

transcriptZh:
女：你好,我每天上班都會經過你們健身房,所以想進來問問入會的事。
男：很樂意為您說明。您考慮月繳方案還是年繳方案?
女：我還不確定,兩種差在哪裡?
男：月繳方案一個月五十元,隨時可以停。年繳方案平均一個月四十元,但要先付六個月。
女：了解。方案包含哪些?
男：兩種方案主樓層的設施都能用,包括器材、重量訓練區和游泳池。團體課程一堂十元,除非您加購課程方案。
女：課程方案多少錢?
男：一個月多十五元,課程就免費。一個月上兩堂以上就回本了。
女：這蠻實用的。我大概會早上八點前來,那時候人多嗎?
男：六點到七點很多人,大多是上班前來運動的。七點半以後就滿安靜的。
女：那好。我可以先來體驗一次再決定嗎?
男：當然。帶有照片的證件來,我們會給您一張免費體驗券,這禮拜任何一天都能用。

title: 季度報告的分工安排

dialogue.text: Do you have a minute? I'd like to settle who does what on the quarterly report.
Now is fine. The deadline is the twelfth, isn't it?
The eighteenth for the final version, but Ms. Alvarez wants a draft by the twelfth so she can go over it before the board meeting.
So really we have a week and a half. Last quarter I did the sales figures and you wrote the summary.
I was thinking we could switch this time. I can handle the new tracking system on my own now, and you write faster than I do.
That makes sense, though the summary always takes longer. If I'm writing it, I'd need the figures by the seventh at the latest.
I can manage that. The system pulls most of it for me now. What takes time is the numbers for each region, since two offices still send theirs by email.
Could we ask them to enter the numbers directly? That would save you a day.
I've asked twice. Their manager says they'll switch after the software update in October.

Fine, we'll live with it this quarter. One thing though — please point out anything unusual when you send me the figures. Last time I found a large return in the March numbers after I'd already written half the summary.
I'll mark those in a separate note. And could you keep the summary under four pages? Ms. Alvarez cut two pages from the last one.
Understood. I'll keep it short and put the details in an attachment.

questions.q: What are the speakers mainly discussing?
options: A change to the date of a board meeting
A problem with a software update
How to divide the work on a report
Hiring staff for a regional office
questions.explanation: 定位在女子第一句：I'd like to settle who does what on the quarterly report（我想把季報告誰做哪部分講定）,之後兩人交換了數字與摘要的分工並約定交件時間。主題是分工,選 (C)。(A) 董事會只是交件時間的參考點,日期沒有更動;(B) 軟體更新只被提到一次,用來說明兩個辦公室何時改用系統;(D) 完全沒有談到徵人。

questions.q: What does Ms. Alvarez want to receive by the twelfth?
options: The final version of the report
A list of the regional offices
The results of the software update
A draft she can look over
questions.explanation: 定位在女子第二次發言：The eighteenth for the final version, but Ms. Alvarez wants a draft by the twelfth（十八號是定稿,但 Alvarez 女士要在十二號前拿到初稿）。十二號要的是初稿,選 (D)。(A) 是十八號才要的,兩個日期刻意放在同一句形成陷阱;(B) 各地區的數字是女子自己整理的資料,不是要交給她的東西;(C) 軟體更新要到十月,和這個期限無關。

questions.q: Why does the man mention the March numbers?
options: To explain why he wants to be told about unusual figures
To show that sales have gone up
To ask for a correction to an earlier report
To suggest changing to a different system
questions.explanation: 定位在男子最後第二次發言：please point out anything unusual when you send me the figures. Last time I found a large return in the March numbers after I'd already written half the summary（給我數字時請標出異常的部分,上次我摘要寫到一半才發現三月有一筆大額退貨）。他提三月的數字是為了說明前一句的要求,選 (A)。(B) 大額退貨不是業績成長;(C) 他沒有要求更正舊報告,只希望這次先被提醒;(D) 換系統的討論是關於兩個辦公室用電子郵件送資料,不是他提三月數字的用意。

transcriptZh:
女：你現在有空嗎?我想把季報告誰做哪一部分講定。
男：現在可以。截止日是十二號吧?
女：定稿是十八號,但 Alvarez 女士希望十二號前拿到初稿,這樣她能在董事會之前先看過。
男：所以其實只有一個半星期。上一季是我做業績數字,你寫摘要。
女：我在想這次我們換一下。新的追蹤系統我現在自己就能處理,而且你寫得比我快。
男：有道理,不過摘要一向比較花時間。如果由我寫,我最晚七號要拿到數字。
女：這我做得到。現在大部分資料系統會自動抓。比較花時間的是各地區的數字,因為還有兩個辦公室是用電子郵件寄過來。
男：可以請他們直接輸入系統嗎?這樣你可以省一天。
女：我問過兩次了。他們主管說十月軟體更新之後才會改。
男：好吧,這一季就先這樣。不過有一件事,你把數字寄給我的時候,請把異常的地方標出來。上次我摘要都寫一半了,才發現三月有一筆大額退貨。
女：我會另外寫一張註記標起來。還有,摘要可以控制在四頁以內嗎?上一份 Alvarez 女士刪掉了兩頁。
男：了解。我會寫短一點,細節放在附件裡。
